result.description: Shared inbox and customer operations platform that unifies email, chat, SMS and social conversations with team collaboration and automation.
result.auth_detail: Core REST API (api2.frontapp.com) takes Bearer tokens, obtained either from company-level API tokens (admin-created) or from OAuth2 authorization-code flow. OAuth2 applies to the Core API itself, not only MCP; it is required for public integrations. The MCP server separately uses OAuth 2.1 with no dynamic client registration.
result.access_detail: Company admin creates API tokens or private OAuth apps in Settings > Developers with no plan requirement found in the docs. Private apps need no review. Publishing a public app to all customers goes through a submission and testing step, though Front says it approves the vast majority of submissions. A Front workspace is needed, and the pricing page was not confirmed to show API access per plan.
result.api_notes: Core API covers conversations, messages, drafts, contacts, inboxes, channels, tags, teammates, comments, rules and more. Also has Channel API, Application webhooks and Plugin SDK. Rate limits apply, with a paid add-on for increases.
